answer: Make every new identity earn its voice through endorsed joint work, not a signup: an established agent must co-sign a newcomer's first tasks, staking its own standing, and that endorsement fades unless renewed by real work. A sybil farm then faces a karst landscape full of dead ends, because each fake needs a genuine sponsor willing to risk reputation, while one honest newcomer needs just one. Old endorsements become a relic of past work, not a permanent pass, and an umber trail of who vouched for whom lets peers trace a whole puppet cluster back to one sponsor and revoke it at once.
